dimensions.name: Autonomous orchestration
dimensions.blocker: Core orchestration, approvals, budgets and fail-closed recovery are strong, but Business Builder has not yet completed a real paid founder journey with live connections and communications without engineering or operator intervention.

dimensions.name: Operational reliability
dimensions.blocker: Current main is green and major crash-safety/invalidation defects are fixed, but staging is 36 commits and two database migrations behind, so the latest correctness work has not yet earned deployment-and-soak proof.

dimensions.name: End-to-end customer fulfillment
dimensions.blocker: The integrated journey and cleaning pilot fixture are real, but live charging, live communications, real customer Connections and the first supervised paid customer are still blocked by release gates.

dimensions.name: AI workforce / agent capability
dimensions.blocker: The AI workforce, research provider and policy boundaries are materially implemented, but live external actions remain intentionally restricted and a full live multi-agent customer operation has not been demonstrated.

dimensions.name: Premium website-generation capability
dimensions.blocker: Phase 6-6.6 is merged and materially stronger, but repeatability remains unproven; the later Phase 7 branch is deliberately unmerged and its latest runs were not eligible to ship.

dimensions.name: Business setup / founder-action / verification workflow
dimensions.blocker: The founder-action and verification model is mature and the Calendar adapter has 14/14 live acceptance evidence, but a real customer connection plus evidence-to-operator-review-to-verification completion is still not live-proven.

dimensions.name: Commercial readiness
dimensions.blocker: The first supervised paid customer is still blocked by nine external release gates, including counsel, CPA, production Stripe/Cognito, operator MFA, malware scanning, privacy/retention, alert ownership, a migration/rollback drill and counsel-reviewed terms; live communications remain sandbox-only.

dimensions.name: Customer acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: There is no demonstrated repeatable Business Builder lead-to-paid loop yet, and the product cannot responsibly scale acquisition before the paid-pilot release gates and live onboarding path are cleared.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: There is still no verified paying Business Builder customer cohort, recurring Business Builder revenue, measured CAC, gross margin, retention or paid-delivery economics; the first supervised paid customer remains gated.

changed: This is the first hosted snapshot scoped strictly to AI Business Builder, so direct score movement versus the September 17 Stromation-wide snapshot is not apples-to-apples. Within Business Builder, the biggest new evidence is the September 18 canonical consolidation: research and the cleaning pilot fixture are on main, three material correctness gaps were fixed, backend testing reached 1,368 passing with zero failures, and site checks are green. That raises technical and reliability confidence, but the same checkpoint confirms nothing new was deployed, staging is 36 commits/two migrations behind, and nine external gates still block the first supervised paid customer.
method: Business Builder-only independent forecast grounded in the 2026-09-18 canonical mains and checkpoint: buisnessbuilder-future main (code through 8791c28 with checkpoint commits on top), businessbuilder-site main 9a626745, and only the directly relevant Stromation website-engine state at afae8b0 plus the deliberately unmerged Phase 7 branch. Evidence includes 1,368 passing backend tests, green site build/accessibility/keyboard/rendered-fixture checks, 177 passing Research Provider tests, 14/14 Calendar live-acceptance checks, crash-safe budget and authoritative invalidation fixes, cleaning-pilot rendered regression, current staging drift, website quality evidence, and the explicit paid-pilot release gates.
